## How I checked it

- [ ] `npm run check` passes (lint, tests, build)
- [ ] Tried it in the browser (`npm run dev`)
- [ ] Added or updated a test if I changed contrast maths, upload checks or exported code

## Security checklist

- [ ] No new network requests, analytics, or third-party scripts (the CSP blocks them anyway)
- [ ] No user input reaches exported CSS/HTML unescaped
- [ ] No new dependency, or I explained below why it is needed
